credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/snowdrop.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. BRACED: a plump papery bulb half sunk in a snow crust, cream body under a pale tunic with dry brown tunic lines, one blunt grey-green leaf spear piercing the neck. The spear pushes up through the crust. Snow, leaves and scape stay fixed; only the signature part moves. No enclosed dark dots: every inner-tepal chevron joins its tip's outline. Sport: Galanthus nivalis Sandersii Group, yellow ovary and inner marks, so the dark slot becomes a yellow-olive; geometry stays identical.
